When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended.

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Bread & Beans
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Bread is a pillar of the Italian cuisine, but beans are the base in many of the Italian regions too. Lidia makes crostini two ways, monkfish brodetto with cannellini, and talks about garlic bread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - Famous Cheese Of Wisconsin
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The upper Midwest state is famous for its 'cheese heads' and proudly declares itself America's Dairyland because it produces more cheese than any other state in the USA.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Between The Bread
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buddy sees what's between the bread at two old school joints that hold a special place in his heart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy - All About Meat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Sophie explores how her Puglian neighbours eat and cook meat. She makes orecchiette pasta with meatballs, then visits her neighbour's countryside plot to cook pasta al forno and bombette.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Kristianstad, Sweden
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Located in Sweden's south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero - The Beauty Of Badu
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nornie travels to Badu Island. With acclaimed artist Alick Tipoti, they prepare delicious dishes using fresh local ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - English Theme
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Simon's on a mission to get back to his English 'Food Roots' with classic ingredients like Stilton cheese and pork sausages.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura heads to the beautiful McLaren Vale to make an Indian-style Fish Curry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Stuffed Poblanos With Bacon Green Onion Rice
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael turns charred poblano peppers into a savory sensation, stuffing them with sauteed meats and a colourful vegetable medley, topping them with cheese, and baking until golden brown.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Amaretti biscuits take centre stage as Luca explores their sweet and savoury potential.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Muhammad from Naheeda's Choice at the Prahran Market makes a very tasty Lebanese Kebab for Laura.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Potatoes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Everyone loves potatoes. Jamie enthuses about these underground jewels and makes the perfect potato salad using freshly dug wonderful new potatoes at their best.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Kirsten Tibbals joins Justine on today's episode where she gives you a little history and a whole lot of deliciousness with her Paris Brest with Flaked Almonds and Raspberry and Cream Filling.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Mushrooms
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Adam and his guests, globally acclaimed food writer Emiko Davies and hatted chef Alessandro Pavoni put the 'fun' in 'fungi' with a night of mouth-watering mushroom recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Sneak Attack
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Give yourself a nutritional sneak attack with Mary's recipes that cram in the good stuff without skimping on flavour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - One Dish, Two Meals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Weeknight dinners just got easier by Lidia simply serving one recipe two ways! Lidia prepares a zucchini, peas, and pancetta risotto, risotto cakes, and talks about capellini asparagus frittatas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - Haloumi: Cyprus
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Squeaky, salty haloumi is one of the world's best-loved grilled cheeses. However most of it is now mass produced using cows milk. Will heads to the island of Cyprus to see how it's traditionally made.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Flavour Pioneers
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buddy visits two culinary powerhouses who are bringing the flavours of their native countries to the places they now call home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy - Pasta: The Stuff Of Life
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Sydvestjylland, Denmark
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Tareq starts the next leg of his journey by visiting Sydvestjylland-a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts.

However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

actionmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

actionmax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. bbc2.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbc2.uk.description: Series 28 Episode 18: Sydney. Michael Aspel and the team visit Sydney in Australia. The journey is well rewarded as thousands of fans turn out with a remarkable array of treasures. Amongst the items are pieces of furniture made by convicts transported to Australia, a part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship Endeavour, and a collector of items belonging to opera star Maria Callas receives one of the biggest valuations in Roadshow history.

bbc2.uk.title: Flog It!
bbc2.uk.description: Series 11 Episode 39: Hertfordshire. Paul Martin and the `Flog It!' team head to Ashridge House in Hertfordshire, an impressive estate which used to be home to Queen Elizabeth I. Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant join Paul in the hunt for unwanted antiques. Claire is surprised by a Susie Cooper charger with a very unusual design, and Thomas sets his sights on a Royal Worcester coffee set in pristine condition.

bbc2.uk.title: House of Games
bbc2.uk.description: Series 10 Episode 42: Week 9: Tuesday. Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

bbc2.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two

bbc2.uk.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 5. The Bikers continue their journey by heading to north west Wales, a remote but beautiful part of the UK and home to lush, green pastures, towering peaks, breathtaking valleys and 250 miles of stunning coastline.

bbc2.uk.title: Highland Cops

bbc3.uk.description: A round-up of the day's news.

bbc3.uk.title: Horrible Histories
bbc3.uk.description: Famous monk St Augustine struggles to introduce Christianity to Saxon England and Stuart diarist Samuel Pepys annoys the smartest men in Britain. Later, we witness a daring escape from the Tower of London and Joan of Arc's story is quite an unusual one for a teenage girl.

bbc3.uk.title: Horrible Histories - Mardy Mary Queen of Scots Special
bbc3.uk.description: This episode follows Mary Queen of Scots as she stumbles from young girl in Scotland to queen in France, back to queen in Scotland and finally to Elizabeth I's public enemy no 1. Meanwhile, across the world we meet silver-nosed Danish scientist Tycho Brahe.

bbc3.uk.title: The Holiday (2006)
bbc3.uk.description: Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.

bbc3.uk.title: What We Did on Our Holiday (2014)
bbc3.uk.description: Doug and Abi travel to the Scottish Highlands with their three children to visit Doug's father for his birthday.

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: When Eric raids the freezer after coming in from a night out, he leaves the door open and all the food inside completely defrosts. Beth has options - chuck it all out? Claim on the insurance? Cook everything at once and invite Cathy, Colin, Ian, Jaz, Christine and Sophie over to eat it all? It's no decision really. Everything goes well until Cathy urges Colin to go next door and get something out of their freezer to replace the defrosted food - a whole, beautiful, Scottish salmon..

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: Disaster following a row with Sophie means that Christine has to stay over at Eric and Beth's. Beth isn't impressed with the new makeover Eric's done of Ian's old room. Cathy and Colin have a bust-up when she discovers that Colin has been using his laptop for something quite unrelated to work.

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: Ian and Jaz have invited Beth and Cathy over to theirs for a quiet drink but Cathy's over-exuberant dancing causes consternation with the downstairs neighbour. Colin and Eric discover they have some time to kill before the start of their evening watching Andy Murray play tennis but their choice of activity leads to Christine being much more involved in their night than they'd have liked. Sophie has to return from a rare night out to check on her mother.

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: It's Eric's birthday tomorrow and all he wants is a bit of peace and quiet. Cathy and Colin decide to pop in early as they're going to be away `sailing'. Christine and Sophie have just returned from a funeral and Christine needs to tell everyone what fun it's been. Ian and Jaz have completely forgotten that it's Eric's birthday, and there's great embarrassment amongst the Bairds when their old family photo is dragged out of the loft.

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: Christine just wants to know who the father of her daughter's baby is but Sophie won't tell her. So Christine locks her in the hut. Cathy's been having therapy to work through her issues and now thinks she can counsel other people. Colin challenges Eric to a game of darts but just can't help himself cheating when it looks like Eric might win. Beth, as always, tries to keep the peace but ends up caught right in the middle of it all.

bbc3.uk.title: Two Doors Down
bbc3.uk.description: Eric gets an excellent report from his health check so he and Beth decide to celebrate by booking their first holiday in seven years. Cathy and Colin have built a hot tub in their back garden and are hosting a party to show it off to the neighbours.

bbc3.uk.title: Juice - A Saif Space
bbc3.uk.description: Jamma struggles to balance work, family, friends and Guy. He's bitten off more than he can chew, and he finds himself preoccupied by something lurking beneath the floorboards.

bbc3.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey and her gang, organiser Dilly, carpenter Rob and cleaner Iwan, challenge the Daniels family to sort their life out in seven days. If the family can let go of half of their possessions, the team will then beautifully reorganise their home.

bbc4.uk.title: This Is BBC Four

bbc4.uk.title: Earth's Natural Wonders - Surviving with Animals
bbc4.uk.description: In many of the world's most extraordinary natural wonders there is an abundance of animals. These can be a devastating threat to the people who live there, or they can provide a means of survival, but often at a high price.

bbc4.uk.title: To the Manor Born - Cosmetics
bbc4.uk.description: DeVere negotiates an important business deal with the beautiful Mademoiselle Dutoit, but when she decides to mix busisness with pleasure, he invents a wife... Audrey.

bbc4.uk.title: Keeping Up Appearances - The Rolls-Royce
bbc4.uk.description: When Hyacinth decides that a new car is in order, she aims rather higher than most people - much to Richard's horror.

bbc4.uk.title: The Stuarts - A Family At War
bbc4.uk.description: After the Charles II's brother, the Catholic James VII & II, was deposed by protestant William of Orange in 1688, Britain became a constitutional monarchy. But the so-called 1688 `Glorious Revolution' came at a price.

bbc4.uk.title: The Longest Goodbye (2023)
bbc4.uk.description: NASA intends to send astronauts to Mars. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E3 Shetland Pony Macaroni Change is afoot for the family as Stacey and Joe discover they've found a buyer for Pickle Cottage and take another step towards moving house. They also visit a Shetland pony sanctuary and soon have their sights set on bringing some miniature ponies home, while Joe's lake project sees them finally releasing fish into the water. Zach has to pass a lifeguarding course before he can leave for his American adventure.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E10 The fourth and final week of heats begins with six new chefs taking on a skills test in which they must fillet a sea bream and use it to create a shellfish risotto, finished with a spinach garnish. Then they serve up a signature dish - knowing that judges Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti will soon be getting rid of one of them.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Tall Tales & Murder
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E4 Paul and Bridget race to get heart medicine to Grinner and keep their treasure hunt alive, risking life and limb from Bridget's driving and unaware that Bee Man Beglan is on their trail. As Matron urges Bunny to give up his boy scout morals and agree to Wesley's demand for a swap, a glimpse back to the 1990s reveals the depth of Bunny and Matron's relationship and throws their dilemma about Maurice into sharp perspective.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Mauritanian
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Biographical drama starring Tahar Rahim and Jodie Foster. In the mid 2000s, US lawyer Nancy Hollander becomes involved in the defence of Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who is being detained in Guantánamo Bay under suspicion of participating in the 9/11 terrorist attacks. Though Hollander initially doubts Slahi's claims of innocence, the evidence in his favour mounts and a series of shocking truths are uncovered.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Sangre de Cholo
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Un joven estudiante de literatura viaja a la frontera buscando sus raíces, pero las cosas no salen como él espera, sino que se le complica la vida.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Comando Negro Exterminio
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Un grupo que solía ser parte de la gran familia desean estar juntos de nuevo. No son policías y en su mayoría no son héroes, sino todo lo contrario: son ejecutores que matan a miembros de la delincuencia organizada. Están en busca de venganza y han vuelto para ser los asesinos de los asesinos.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: El Vecindario II
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: El chofer de una familia adinerada es un violador en las noches, pero sus víctimas no lo acusan.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Mujeres infieles 3
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Tres historias: un hombre es abandonado por su mujer, una modelo exitosa le es infiel a su agencia y el encuentro de una mujer y un hombre que engañan a sus parejas.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: La reyna del Pacífico
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Dos grandes carteles del narcotráfico están enfrascados en una pelea por territorios y una mujer tiene que encontrar la manera de acabar con el enfrentamiento.

cinemax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy.

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

cinemax.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

cinemax.us.title: Shut In
cinemax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside.

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxaction.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The East
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish.

cinemaxaction.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxaction.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemaxaction.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Life After
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A single mother and Indian immigrant travels to New York City to clear out her daughter's apartment.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Walkabout
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Last Emperor
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxclassics.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Contagion
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (movie) - 2005

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Scream
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (movie) - 1996

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (movie) - 1973

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Head Office
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxhits.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemaxhits.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Judge
cinemaxhits.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Hidden Figures
cinemaxhits.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world.

cinemaxhits.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Rampage
cinemaxhits.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxhits.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxhits.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Thousand Words
cinemaxhits.us.description: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Art of Getting By
cinemaxhits.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxhits.us.title: Time Bandits
cinemaxhits.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxwest.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxwest.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxwest.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxwest.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

cinesony.us.title: Married Life
cinesony.us.description: Después de décadas de feliz matrimonio, Harry decide matar a su esposa Pat para que no sufra cuando la abandone por su joven amante. Lo que él no imagina es que su mejor amigo tiene sus propios planes con la amante de Harry.

cinesony.us.title: Take Shelter
cinesony.us.description: Un hombre de Ohio intenta desesperadamente proteger a su familia después de que unas visiones aterradoras lo convencen de que un desastre apocalíptico se cierne sobre ellos.

cinesony.us.title: Cliffhanger
cinesony.us.description: Un alpinista y sus captores se persiguen por peligrosas montañas, en una singular lucha por obtener un dinero robado.

cinesony.us.title: Southland Tales
cinesony.us.description: En un futuro distópico, los destinos de cuatro personas se entrelazan con los de toda la humanidad cuando una nueva tecnología amenaza con destruir el mundo.

cinesony.us.title: Pineapple Express
cinesony.us.description: Dale Denton, cuyo trabajo es entregar citaciones legales, le compra marihuana a una mula que se llama Saúl. El traficante quiere hacerse amigo suyo, pero Dale solo está interesado en los negocios.

cinevault.us.title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
cinevault.us.description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

cinevault.us.title: The River Murders
cinevault.us.description: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims.

cinevault.us.title: Maximum Risk
cinevault.us.description: French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death.

cinevault.us.title: Desperate Measures
cinevault.us.description: Widowed cop Frank Conner (Andy Garcia) is determined to secure a bone marrow transplant for his son, Matt (Joseph Cross), who will die of leukemia if a suitable donor isn't found. Conner discovers that incarcerated serial murderer Peter McCabe (Michael Keaton) is a match for Matt, and the psychopath eventually agrees to donate marrow, but he escapes from the operating room just before the procedure. Conner quickly follows, but the scheming McCabe won't be easily apprehended.

cinevault.us.title: Mortal Thoughts
cinevault.us.description: A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him.

cinevault.us.title: Obsessed
cinevault.us.description: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Denver McKee
circlecountry.us.description: The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Day of Reckoning
circlecountry.us.description: Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - The Abduction
circlecountry.us.description: Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
circlecountry.us.description: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
circlecountry.us.description: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Elly Becomes a Secretary
circlecountry.us.description: Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Jethro's Friend
circlecountry.us.description: One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.

circlecountry.us.title: Wild Horses
circlecountry.us.description: An ex-rodeo rider (Kenny Rogers) leaves his family in Texas and goes to Wyoming for a government round-up.

circlecountry.us.title: The Gambler
circlecountry.us.description: An Old West poker player (Kenny Rogers) acquires a sidekick (Bruce Boxleitner) and sets out to help the son he never knew.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - The Mission
circlecountry.us.description: Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - The Stranger
circlecountry.us.description: As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate and the Manpower Problem
circlecountry.us.description: An old friend of Kate tells the girls to dig up some eligible prospects, in order to get Kate married again.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ladybugs
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe wants to cash in on the recent Beatlemania fever, by making up a girl group named The Ladybugs, starring his nieces and Sheriff Ragsdale's daughter.

circletv.us.title: The Hooterville Flivverball
circletv.us.description: Uncle Jo plans to use Orville Miggs' flivver to power his own railroad and bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball.

circletv.us.title: Jon Pardi ERNEST Tanya Tucker
circletv.us.description: Saturday-night showcase of country-music stars performing their biggest hits at Nashville's famed Grand Ole Opry.

circletv.us.title: Breakout
circletv.us.description: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

circletv.us.title: Violent City
circletv.us.description: A lone high-priced hit man (Charles Bronson) gets even with an underworld boss (Telly Savalas) to avenge a double cross.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 5 in c-Moll, op. 67
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Ludwig van Beethovens berühmter 5. Symphonie in c-Moll, Op. 67. Hat Beethovens berühmte Fünfte immer noch die Kraft, uns alle zu überraschen?

classica.us.title: Liszts 1. Klavierkonzert & Mahlers 5. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Michael Tilson Thomas dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Franz Liszts Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 in Es-Dur und Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 5. Der tschechische Pianist Lukáš Vondráček ist der Solist in Liszts Konzert.

classica.us.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen.

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur.

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt.

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Who's Wooing Who? Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Mona is offered a different job at another record label, she must decide whether to stay or move on.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Mothers for Others Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Big Dee Dee crashes Phyllis' charity telethon meeting, Phyllis loses it and tells everyone that Big Dee Dee was pregnant before she married Charles.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Thorne in My Side Episode
cleotv.us.description: When Phyllis gets into trouble with her Homeowner's Association, Dee Dee defends her, but winds up causing more trouble.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Pomp & Circumstance Episode
cleotv.us.description: As law school graduation draws near, Dee Dee feels pressure because she has no job yet; Mona panics when Phyllis finds a fantastic apartment in her neighborhood.

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Gen-Why Me? Episode
cleotv.us.description: Mona's insecurities threaten her budding relationship with her new tenant, Lorenzo.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - OVER
cleotv.us.description: Just when Shelly thinks she and J.T. are making progress, she learns that his idea of compromise involves her changing who she is.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Self Helpless
cleotv.us.description: Shelly reads a self-help book that encourages her to spend time with herself in order to get over her breakup.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - All My Exes Havin' Sexes
cleotv.us.description: Rita and Janie warn Shelly about sleeping with J.T., but Shelly ignores them until she realizes that she is behaving as if she and J.T. were still together.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - The Hate-Trix Reloaded
cleotv.us.description: Shelly takes the advice of a self-help book and sends an e-mail to J.T. asking for her stuff, sparking petty attempts at payback that spiral out of control.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Footloose
cleotv.us.description: When Shelly turns to J.T. for help with a knee injury, she ends up getting a date with a doctor and making J.T. jealous.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Splice of Life
cleotv.us.description: Shelly feels left out when Rita, after being evicted, comes to stay with Janie and the two rediscover their Cajun roots together.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Love Is a Royal Pain
cleotv.us.description: Nikki attends her high-school reunion with professor Oglevee, while Kim secretly dates her mother's old flame.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Funny, Funny Valentine
cleotv.us.description: When Nikki finds out that professor Oglevee is going to propose to Veronica, she spends the evening with her ex-husband.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - A Simple Plan
cleotv.us.description: Nikki and the others try to exploit Kim's newfound wealth when she finds $250,000 hidden in her used car.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Moving On Out

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city.

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it.

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started

He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000.

After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - From Lifeless Studs to a Modern Beach House
magnolianetwork.us.description: A Connecticut house flipper is on the hunt for a property with a beach view that he can call his own; after years of renovating houses for others to use, he is ready to find a vacation home that he and his family can escape to for some quality time.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Renovating a York, Maine Family Getaway
magnolianetwork.us.description: A native New Englander who grew up vacationing on the shores of York, Maine, is hoping to achieve his dream of owning a home in town; property in York isn't cheap, but having a place to build memories could be worth dealing with a major renovation.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Renovating to Recreate Memories in Hull, Massachusetts
magnolianetwork.us.description: A single mother who spent her childhood on Nantasket Beach searches for a home along the shores of Hull, Massachusetts; she hopes to find an affordable property she can rehab to create the same cherished memories she had for her children.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Narragansett Bay Renovation
magnolianetwork.us.description: A house flipping couple from San Diego have decided to cross the country to find their very own vacation home along the shores of Narragansett Bay, Rhode Island; they hope this property will provide their daughter lasting memories.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Cutting Costs on the New Jersey Coast
magnolianetwork.us.description: A New Jersey family sets their sights on Ocean County, where canal homes allow residents to enjoy the ocean and the bays created by a barrier island; after years of visiting family and friends, buying a home will give them a place to call their own.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Ambitious Beach Dreams in Corolla, North Carolina
magnolianetwork.us.description: A couple who met along the shores of Corolla, N.C., searches for a home in town they can renovate into their dream vacation getaway, but finding an affordable beach property they can transform on schedule and budget could be a challenge.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Family Spot in the Poconos
magnolianetwork.us.description: A New Jersey family of five looks for a lakefront getaway in Pennsylvania's Pocono Mountains - they want a property they can put their personal stamp on, but with a limited budget, they need all hands on deck to keep costs down. (House/garden, Home improvement) - 2021-10-15

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Brick House
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The Cordrays tackle one of their most expensive projects ever in a town they both love; close to the beach and parade routes, the brick home exudes class, functionality and becomes one of Michael's favorite projects.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Craftsman Camelback
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Camelbacks are not common in Galveston, Texas, but the challenge is to make this one a historic head-turner; the Cordrays transform the attic into a cozy family space and build an outdoor sofa that a Gulf storm can't destroy.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Restoring Galveston - His and Hers
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Ashley and Michael let the fun and games begin as they tackle his and hers shotgun homes in a friendly competition to bring style and new life back to these two unique houses located just a couple blocks from the beach.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Old Mill Wedding
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Michael and Ashley turn a dilapidated wood mill from 1908 into a wedding venue complete with limestone-like stamped concrete, a wedding arbor, lathe table bar, a grand staircase and two dressing suites.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Breaking Free
maverickblackcinema.us.description: When his wife is murdered in their own home, Joe, an undercover cop, spirals out of control with alcohol and substance abuse. When he's seen by an old girlfriend on the street, she helps him to heal his spirit, along with finding justice for his wife.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Rhythm and Revenge
maverickblackcinema.us.description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: How Did We Get Here
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: The Jealous Son
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: But I'm Married
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Kimora and Jamal's seemingly perfect marriage falters. Seeking to reignite passion, Kimora explores unconventional options, including a third person. This decision unleashes a web of lies and betrayal, forcing Kimora to confront hidden desires.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Redemption
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Lost and grieving, Chris seeks solace in the wrong crowd. A chance encounter with the enigmatic Patrick leads him down a dangerous path, forcing him to confront his own morality and the consequences of his choices.

megatv.us.title: Al Ritmo de Esta Noche tu Night
megatv.us.description: Una recapitulación de los mejores momentos y entrevistas del comediante Alexis Valdés.

megatv.us.title: Arelys Henao, aún queda mucho por cantar
megatv.us.description: La carrera profesional de Arelys va viento en popa, pero surgen nuevas amenazas y enemigos mientras ella trata de conjugar la exigencia del mundo de la música con las necesidades de su familia.

megatv.us.title: Mega News
megatv.us.description: Un programa con una propuesta visual y moderna, con un estilo único de presentar las noticias nacionales de una manera breve y precisa, con reportajes y coberturas especiales.

megatv.us.title: De buena fuente

megatv.us.title: Sánchez Grass en América
megatv.us.description: Análisis de la política nacional a través de una conversación que ofrece diferentes opiniones y puntos de vista.
