metv.us.description: While the family makes Thanksgiving preparations, John-Boy awaits a visit from his girlfriend (Sian Barbara Allen).

metv.us.title: Gunsmoke - All That
metv.us.description: Rancher Cliff Shanks succumbs to life as a gold prospector after suffering the loss of his wife, land and cattle.

metv.us.title: Bonanza - The Running Man
metv.us.description: A woman persuades Candy and Little Joe to protect her husband, a government surveyor who saw a land baron's men killing homesteaders.

metv.us.title: The Rifleman - Lariat
metv.us.description: An old friend of Lucas returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.

metv.us.title: The Rifleman - Smoke Screen
metv.us.description: Several men are vying for a rancher's daughter's affections; when she is found dead, one of them becomes the prime suspect in her murder.

metv.us.title: Wagon Train - The Jesse Cowan Story
metv.us.description: A man returns from the Civil War to find his home and family destroyed as the result of a feud and heads West to seek his revenge.

metv.us.title: Emergency! - Virus
metv.us.description: A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Movie Tonight
metv.us.description: Col. Potter plans to show his all-time favorite Western as a pick-me-up for the company's badly sagging morale.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Souvenirs
metv.us.description: Hawkeye and B.J. decide to do something about a helicopter pilot who uses natives to gather battlefield bric-a-brac to sell as war souvenirs.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Post Op
metv.us.description: The surgical teams must somehow cope with a critical shortage of blood during a grueling 18-hour operating session.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Margaret's Marriage
metv.us.description: Maj. Houlihan's fiancé arrives at the 4077th and shocks Frank by asking him to be his best man.

metv.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Family Visit
metv.us.description: Andy's patience is tried when the Taylors are visited by relatives.

metvplus.us.title: The Rookies - Prelude to Vengeance
metvplus.us.description: A girl befriended by the rookies will be charged with her robber boyfriend's crime if he can't be apprehended; guest Andy Robinson.

metvplus.us.title: Hart to Hart - With This Hart, I Thee Wed
metvplus.us.description: Jennifer's aunt (Eva Gabor) weds for the seventh time, but the groom dies while eating wedding cake.

metvplus.us.title: Hart to Hart - Million Dollar Harts
metvplus.us.description: A gambler entrusts Jennifer with a briefcase full of money, later switched for counterfeit; guest Simon MacCorkindale.

metvplus.us.title: Diagnosis Murder - A Model Murder
metvplus.us.description: Mark and Steve enter the glamorous world of modeling to track down an unlikely killer after the murder of a private investigator.

metvplus.us.title: Diagnosis Murder - Murder Can Be Murder
metvplus.us.description: Mark discovers a case of insurance fraud in the hospital when a hasty cremation follows the misidentification of a corpse.

metvplus.us.title: Fantasy Island - Roarke's Sacrifice; The Butler's Affair
metvplus.us.description: A dancer (Cyd Charisse) wants her damaged legs healed; a rich widow (Lee Meriwether) wants her butler to say he loves her.

metvplus.us.title: Charlie's Angels - Angels on Skates
metvplus.us.description: The Angels witness a broad-daylight kidnapping while roller-skating on the Venice boardwalk.

metvplus.us.title: Charlie's Angels - Angels on Campus
metvplus.us.description: Charlie suspects a white-slavery ring is at fault in the sudden disappearance of two members of Tiffany's old college sorority.

mgmplus.us.title: Criminal Law
mgmplus.us.description: Up-and-coming Boston attorney Ben Chase successfully defends wealthy Martin Thiel on the charge of a particularly vicious murder. Within 24 hours, another similarly styled murder occurs -- with a new twist that allows Chase to realize he has allowed a guilty man to run free. Chase is startled when Thiel contacts him, requesting he defend him again. Recklessly agreeing in order to gather evidence against Thiel, Chase is soon dragged into the killer's twisted game.

mgmplus.us.title: The Package
mgmplus.us.description: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in a way he couldn't have imagined.

mgmplus.us.title: Out of Time
mgmplus.us.description: Matt Lee Whitlock (Denzel Washington) is the police chief of a small Florida town, going through a divorce with his detective wife, Alex (Eva Mendes). He begins a passionate affair with Ann (Sanaa Lathan), only to find out that she's stricken with terminal cancer. Matt steals a large sum of money confiscated from a drug bust in order to pay for Ann's treatment -- but when she apparently dies in a suspicious fire, the money disappears, and all the clues point to Matt as the culprit.

mgmplus.us.title: Black Rain
mgmplus.us.description: New York City policemen Nick (Michael Douglas) and Charlie (Andy Garcia) witness a murder in a bar and quickly apprehend the assailant. The killer, named Sato (Yusaku Matsuda), is a member of Japan's infamous Yakuza mob, and Nick and Charlie must transport the gangster back to Osaka for his murder trial. There, Sato's fellow gangsters free him from police custody, forcing Nick and Charlie to scour Japan's dangerous underworld of organized crime in search of their fugitive.

mgmplus.us.title: New Wave - Message in a Bottle
mgmplus.us.description: Inspired by punk's DIY energy and David Bowie, a new generation of outsider artists sparks a movement that becomes known as New Wave.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Chasing Amy
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A young cartoonist falls for a fellow artist, a lesbian with a long list of former lovers, creating an unexpected relationship.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Step Brothers
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Two lazy, immature men become rivals when the marriage of one's mother and the other's father forces them to live as siblings in the same house.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Lenny
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: 1950s comic Lenny Bruce (Dustin Hoffman) spurs controversy with his drug use, graphic language and marriage to a stripper (Valerie Perrine).

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Children of a Lesser God
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Rain Man
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Leaving Las Vegas
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Intent on drinking himself to death, a man (Nicolas Cage) who has lost everything finds solace with a Las Vegas hooker (Elisabeth Shue). (Movies, Drama) - 1995

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Children of a Lesser God
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff. (Movies, Drama) - 1986

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Flashbacks tell the story of a tenderfoot who rose to glory by gunning down the outlaw terrorizing his small town. (Movies, Western) - 1962

mgmplushits.us.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
mgmplushits.us.description: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

mgmplushits.us.title: Class
mgmplushits.us.description: Naive Midwestern prep student Jonathan (Andrew McCarthy) bonds with his more worldly roommate, Skip (Rob Lowe), who takes the small-town boy under his wing. At Skip's urging, the inexperienced Jonathan is emboldened to seek out older women in the cocktail lounges of nearby Chicago, where he meets and beds the alluring Ellen (Jacqueline Bisset), who unfortunately turns out to be Skip's mother. The division between the friends is further deepened when a cheating scandal engulfs the school.

mgmplushits.us.title: Action Point
mgmplushits.us.description: D.C. is the crackpot owner of Action Point -- a low-rent, out-of-control amusement park where the rides are designed with minimum safety for maximum fun. Just as his estranged daughter Boogie comes to visit, a corporate mega-park opens nearby and jeopardizes the future of Action Point. To save his beloved park and his relationship with Boogie, D.C. and his loony crew of misfits must risk everything to pull out all the stops and save the day.

mgmplushits.us.title: North Dallas Forty
mgmplushits.us.description: A brutal satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family is bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches. The National Football League refused to help in the production of this movie, suggesting it may have been too near the truth for comfort. From the novel by former NFL player Peter Gent.

mgmplushits.us.title: Baywatch
mgmplushits.us.description: When a dangerous crime wave hits the beach, the legendary Mitch Buchannon leads his elite squad of lifeguards on a mission to prove that you don't have to wear a badge to save the bay. Joined by a trio of hotshot recruits, including former Olympian Matt Brody, they ditch the surf and go deep undercover to take down a ruthless businesswoman whose devious plans threaten the future of the bay.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Institute - Double Cross
mgmplushits.us.description: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Red Eye
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Hunted
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: "The Hunted" is a suspense thriller about a tracker, Bonham (Tommy Lee Jones), who teams up with FBI agent Abby Durrell (Connie Nielsen) to hunt down a trained assassin Hallam (Benicio del Toro). With precision and skill, the predator remains one step ahead, and escapes into the city.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Hannibal
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Seven years have passed since Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) escaped from custody. The doctor is now at large in Europe. Mason Verger (Gary Oldman) remembers Lecter too, and is obsessed with revenge. Verger was Dr. Lecter's sixth victim, and though horribly disfigured, has survived. Verger realizes that to draw the doctor into the open, he must use someone as bait: Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore).

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: 2 Days in the Valley
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Dosmo Pizzo (Danny Aiello), an ordinary guy, finds himself involved in a murder-for-hire scheme. He is betrayed by his partner, the strangely serene Lee Woods (James Spader), who leaves him for dead. Suspecting that Woods will come back to finish him, Dosmo takes an obnoxious art dealer (Greg Cruttwell) and his sweet-natured assistant (Glenne Headly) hostage. Meanwhile, a rookie policeman (Eric Stoltz) investigating the murder begins to suspect that some kind of conspiracy is behind it.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Fish Called Wanda
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: British gangster George Thomason (Tom Georgeson) and his hapless aide, Ken Pile (Michael Palin), draft a pair of arrogant Americans, grifter Wanda Gerschwitz (Jamie Lee Curtis) and weapons expert Otto West (Kevin Kline), for a massive diamond heist. When the job goes badly, Wanda attempts to seduce George's stuffy lawyer, Archie Leach (John Cleese), to find out where George hid the diamonds. Meanwhile, Ken repeatedly attempts to kill an elderly woman (Patricia Hayes) who witnessed the robbery.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Harlem Nights
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Devil's Brigade
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Force 10 From Navarone
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Train
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Pork Chop Hill
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Strange Invaders
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Unaware the entire citizenry has been replaced by aliens, a professor arrives in a Midwestern town looking for his ex-wife who vanished.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Invaders From Mars
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this thrilling creature feature, a young boy’s life is turned upside-down when alien invaders intent on taking over the world land in his backyard!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Invasion Of The Body Snatchers
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Under cover of darkness, while an unsuspecting city sleeps, an alien life form begins to sow the seeds of unspeakable terror. Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Leonard Nimoy, Veronica Cartwright & Jeff Goldblum star in this classic suspense thriller.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Dark Half
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Scalphunters
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Sam Whiskey
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Duel at Diablo
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Apache Natives are after Ellen (Bibi Andersson), her baby, and her husband, William (Dennis Weaver). The family crosses paths with Jess (James Garner), a man who is trying to find out who killed his own wife, a Native American woman. He begins to travel with the couple, but the trailing Apaches soon chase them all into a canyon. Jess is able to escape the situation and alert nearby soldiers. In the process, he also discovers a shocking revelation about his wife's death.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Hour of the Gun
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Doc
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: In this take on the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach) travels to Tombstone, Ariz., with prostitute Katie Elder (Faye Dunaway). Although the trip is difficult because Doc is ill with tuberculosis, they eventually reach their destination, where Holliday is reunited with his old friend Marshal Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin), who has been clashing with the Clanton gang. Tension between Earp and the Clantons rises until their infamous final showdown brings it to a head.

militaryhistory.us.description: Head-to-head speed-shooting showdown; the contestants get surprise visitors to help train.

militaryhistory.us.title: The Lost Evidence - Stalingrad
militaryhistory.us.description: German and Soviet soldiers clash in the city of Stalingrad for nearly six months in 1942 and 1943.

militaryhistory.us.title: The Color of War - Aftermath
militaryhistory.us.description: America emerges as leader of the free world.

militaryhistory.us.title: Tales of the Gun - Guns of Mauser
militaryhistory.us.description: The Mauser bolt-action rifle is an important military shoulder arm.

militaryhistory.us.description: Body armor; accuracy of a medieval crossbow; how World War I pilots shot through their propellers.

militaryhistory.us.title: Mail Call - Civil War Cannoneers; Night Vision; Clearing a Minefield
militaryhistory.us.description: Aiming Civil War artillery pieces; how night-vision technology works; how to clear a minefield.

militaryhistory.us.description: Operating the LCAC; cavalry saddles, used in the Old West; how gas masks work.

militaryhistory.us.description: Mortar; World War II G.I.'s personal items; American Indian arrows.

militaryhistory.us.description: How fast a Revolutionary War soldier could fire a musket; jousting; how to dig a foxhole.

militaryhistory.us.title: Mail Call - The Pilum; WWII Radios; First Rockets

militaryhistory.us.title: Mail Call - Ninja Weapons; Flamethrower; Military Dogs
militaryhistory.us.description: The weapons of the Japanese Ninja; how flamethrowers work; what military dogs do.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Time Machine
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Scientist and inventor Alexander Hartdegen (Guy Pearce) is determined to prove that time travel is possible. His determination is turned to desperation by a personal tragedy that now drives him to want to change the past. Testing his theories with a time machine of his own invention, Hartdegen is hurtled 800,000 years into the future, where he discovers that mankind has divided into the hunter ... and the hunted.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Core
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Super 8
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: In 1979 Ohio, several youngsters (Elle Fanning, Joel Courtney, Gabriel Basso) are making a zombie movie with a Super-8 camera. In the midst of filming, the friends witness a horrifying train derailment and are lucky to escape with their lives. They soon discover that the catastrophe was no accident, as a series of unexplained events and disappearances soon follows. Deputy Jackson Lamb (Kyle Chandler), the father of one of the kids, searches for the terrifying truth behind the crash.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Congo
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Hard Rain
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Peacemaker
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Two trains collide in rural Russia, one of them housing nuclear weapons that go missing after the wreck, and the U.S. government is alerted. Nuclear specialist Dr. Julia Kelly (Nicole Kidman) believes that there will soon be a terrorist attack, so Lt. Col. Thomas Devoe (George Clooney) joins Dr. Kelly as they try to track down the warhead-stealing culprits. They learn that Yugoslav terrorist Gavrich (Marcel Iures) has his hands on the weapons, and he's plotting a devastating attack on New York.

mlbnetwork.us.title: Hot Stove
mlbnetwork.us.description: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

monumentalsportsnetwork.us.description: In this episode of Politics Aside with Chris Cillizza: America's Gladiators, Chris talks military service and fitness with two American warriors serving in Congress. Former Naval Intelligence Officer, Jimmy Panetta (D-CA), and former US Marine and USN Emergency room physician Rich McCormick (R-GA). Along the way, Chris skates through the halls of Congress, takes a stab at the Marine Sword Salute, and has his fitness tested by a real American Gladiator.

monumentalsportsnetwork.us.description: As the Washington Capitals kick off their season, Rachel crashes media day, where players pose for their hero shots in front of green screens and take part in fun games with the digital team. Along the way, she catches up with familiar faces like Tom Wilson and Alex Ovechkin, gets to know some of the team's newest players, and takes the pulse of the team as the puck drops.

more4.uk.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
more4.uk.description: Heli-medics race to a skydiver who's suffered serious injuries after crashing into a house. And there's a race across the country to reach a man who's fallen 40 feet from a ladder. (S3 Ep9)

more4.uk.description: Jo and Graham look for their dream holiday home in Mar Menor, Europe's largest coastal lagoon, on Spain's Costa Blanca. Jasmine Harman shows them impressive properties for their £70k.

more4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
more4.uk.description: John and Sue Blakemore host first, at the Golf House on the Isle of Wight. While breakfast is a big hit, a suspicious stain in the loo proves controversial.

more4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
more4.uk.description: Nick and his best friend Layla welcome their rivals to The New Inn in St John's Wood, London. But guests John and Sue are left cold by their 'corporate and impersonal' room.

more4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
more4.uk.description: At The Bunkroom in Chester, David is determined to prove that hostelling is for everyone - even if his wife isn't convinced. What will the guests make of the bunk beds and budget breakfast?

more4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
more4.uk.description: The last visit of the week is to John Graham's The B&B in Blackpool, where competition between the guests builds during a game of tenpin bowling. And there's tension at the dinner table.

more4.uk.title: Four in a Bed
more4.uk.description: The B&Bers meet one last time to find out how much they've been paid and confront their critics. Tension runs high, but who will be crowned best value B&B of the week?

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

moremax.us.title: The Judge
moremax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man.

moremax.us.title: Hidden Figures
moremax.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world.

moremax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
moremax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Blue Boat
motortrend.us.description: A friend of Kindig-It Design arrives at the shop with a new build that has Dave's creative juices overflowing. It has been a decade since Dave has tackled an Oldsmobile, and he comes up with a design that keeps the car's charm, but also makes it bitchin'.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Stay Bitchin'
motortrend.us.description: Dave Kindig, KevDogg and Will Lockwood take a stroll down memory lane, looking back at the last 10 years.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Jeep Splits and Foreign Whips
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the gang split a nearly perfect 1960 Willys Jeep into four pieces to make it longer, wider and meaner.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Mom-Ster Truck
motortrend.us.description: After John Cena makes a surprise appearance at the shop, Bill and the guys begin to customize John's small 1969 MGC to be a perfect fit; a new customer wants a handmade lifted suspension on his 1920 Denali 2500 as a gift for his wife.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - From the Ground Up
motortrend.us.description: Bill is still being put to the test with a 1928 Ford Rat Rod, a 1942 Ford pickup and a 1975 C10.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Root Beer Cadillac
motortrend.us.description: Bill has never really liked the body of the 1974 Cadillac Eldorado, but when a client wants hers radically redesigned, Ekstensive blends old and new to make it cooler than the rest.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - Bigger, Badder Wrecker
motortrend.us.description: Bill and the team work their magic to customize a brand-new 2022 International wrecker; now that the pristine 1960s Willys Jeep has been quartered, they use imaginative fabrication techniques to make it whole again.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - H1 Hummer-Dinger
motortrend.us.description: An Ekstensive favorite, a 2001 Hummer H1, needs some serious reinforcements; Bill changes things up on his completely custom, all-tube buggy by borrowing technology from monster trucks; Bill puts his daughter to work customizing her 2020 Challenger.

motortrend.us.title: Texas Metal - MGCena
motortrend.us.description: Actor John Cena is amazed by the transformation of his British classic '69 MGC into a custom-built masterpiece with all-American trimmings; the team has to get creative building a chassis and bed for a '60s Jeep Willys entirely from scratch. (Reality, Auto) - 2022-05-25

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Turbo Story Time - Old Timey Car Tales
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Turbo Story Time - Cars, Crime, Curse and Mystery
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Turbo Story Time - Extreme Speed Clubs
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The quest for speed has been ingrained in humans since the birth of the wheel; these are stories of people who gathered like-minded speed freaks and created outlaw cultures of pushing the limits of public roads.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - The Rebirth of a Generation
motortrendfasttv.us.description: To kick off the show, John "Nads" Naderi and Amir Bentatou hatch a plan to afford their dream Civic Type R hatch, go way over budget and celebrate the dawn of a new era of Super Street the best way they know how: with an old-school canyon run.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - Taking a 2015 Subaru BRZ from Fun Commuter to Track-Day Hero
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The boys get their hands on a stock Subaru BRZ; Nads and Amir add some affordable mods to turn it into a respectable track car; they try to turn a fast enough time at the track to gain entry into the exclusive sub-two-minute lap club.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - Beat Down 350Z Drift Missile to Street Shark Dripping With Style
motortrendfasttv.us.description: "Hot Rod Garage" built a Nissan 350Z drifter with a welded differential, hydraulic handbrake, steering angle kit and not much else; then they abandoned it; Nads and Amir try to salvage this one with some much-needed style and a Formula Drift debut.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - JDM Toyota Chaser Goes From Big-Body Drifter to Quarter-Mile Dragger
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The boys score a Japanese-spec, right-hand-drive 1997 Toyota Chaser; it's the perfect recipe for a sideways, big-body drift car, but Nads and Amir want to go in a different direction: straight down the drag strip.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - Classing Things Up With a Japanese-Inspired 2005 Lexus LS 430 VIP
motortrendfasttv.us.description: VIP cars include rare body kits, oversized wheels and slammed ride heights; the boys try to build something that's true to the roots of the space and make it to an exclusive VIP party reveal.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - Giving Our JDM Toyota Chaser a Big Turbo in Pursuit of Big Time Slips
motortrendfasttv.us.description: John Nads Naderi and Amir Bentatou celebrate car tuning spirit, as they transform Japanese performance cars into tuner icons.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Super Street Garage - Amir's Lotus Elise Is Also Our First EURO Complete With a JDM Twist

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina - The Blue Ridge Buckin' Bronco
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy Pike and his crew are no strangers to working on off-road vehicles, so when a client drops off a '74 Bronco, it's game on; they transform this Bronco by dropping a giant engine into a new body, with fresh paint and a fully re-designed interior.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina - The Monster Carlo
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina - Top Secret Impala
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy's dear friend and father figure Kenny sold his 1960 Chevy Impala when he started a family, and has wanted it back ever since; Tommy finds one and plans to restore it, but keeping the secret is more of a challenge than the team ever imagined.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina - I Love It
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy and his team continue the secret '60 Chevy Impala restoration; they revitalize the machine with a new suspension, rebuilt engine and a stunning interior, before reuniting Tommy's father figure with the car of his dreams.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy Pike and his team restore and modernize a 1955 heirloom Chevy truck.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Custom Carolina - Lambo Livin'
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Tommy and his team up the ante by working on a cutting-edge Lamborghini Huracán; the crew feels excited about their supercar project, before realizing what a tricky project they've taken on.

movieplex.us.title: Beautiful Wave
movieplex.us.description: A New York teen (Aimee Teegarden) discovers a family secret while spending the summer in California with her estranged grandmother (Patricia Richardson).

movieplex.us.title: Bernie the Dolphin
movieplex.us.description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

movieplex.us.title: Bernie the Dolphin 2
movieplex.us.description: The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

movieplex.us.title: The Great Gilly Hopkins
movieplex.us.description: Young and feisty Gilly Hopkins (Sophie Nélisse) devises a scheme to escape from her new foster home and reunite with her birth mother.

movieplex.us.title: Bandslam
movieplex.us.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

movieplex.us.title: Face the Music
movieplex.us.description: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

movies.us.title: Chocolat
movies.us.description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

movies.us.title: Ghost
movies.us.description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

movies.us.title: Jerry & Marge Go Large
movies.us.description: When retiree Jerry Selbee discovers a mathematical loophole in the Massachusetts lottery, he and his wife go on an exciting, multimillion dollar winning spree with the goal of reviving their small Michigan town. However, when a selfish college student cheats the system, Jerry must find a way to make the game fair for all.

movies.us.title: Little Wing
movies.us.description: Kaitlyn, a teen, is reeling from her parents' divorce and the pending loss of her home. She and her best friend hope to solve her mother's financial woes by stealing a valuable bird, but Kaitlyn, instead, forms a bond with the owner, giving her a new outlook on life.

movies.us.title: IF
movies.us.description: After discovering she can see everyone's imaginary friends, a girl embarks on a magical adventure to reconnect forgotten IFs with their kids.

movies.us.title: Transformers One
movies.us.description: Brothers-in-arms Orion Pax and D-16 become sworn enemies Optimus Prime and Megatron.

movies.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
movies.us.description: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

movies.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
movies.us.description: After settling in Green Hills, Sonic is eager to prove that he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns with a new partner, Knuckles, in search of a mystical emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands. (movie) - 2022

movies.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
movies.us.description: Sonic, Knuckles and Tails reunite to battle Shadow, a mysterious new enemy with powers unlike anything they've faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, they seek out an unlikely alliance to stop Shadow and protect the planet. (movie) - 2024

movies.us.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
movies.us.description: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers. Their new friend, April O'Neil, helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them. (movie) - 2023

moviesphere.us.title: The Next Three Days
moviesphere.us.description: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

moviesphere.us.title: A Most Wanted Man
moviesphere.us.description: An escaped militant's (Grigoriy Dobrygin) attempt to claim an inheritance gives a German agent (Philip Seymour Hoffman) the chance to lay a trap for a well-regarded Muslim scholar who is suspected of financing terrorists.

moviesphere.us.title: Law Abiding Citizen
moviesphere.us.description: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead.

moviesphere.us.title: Survive the Night
moviesphere.us.description: A trauma doctor is forced to operate on a wounded gunman as he and his family are held hostage by the man and his unhinged brother.

moviesphere.us.title: Flight Risk
moviesphere.us.description: A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be.

moviesphere.us.title: No Escape
moviesphere.us.description: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and George's visit a restaurant, where they have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Police Boat
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig, complete with costumes and a Jolly Roger flag. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Police
nickjr.uk.description: Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel have come to teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: The Smurfs - Hogatha's Heart Throb
nickjr.uk.description: Smurfette and Grouchy compete to decide who is the best in 'The Battle of the Sitters', and in 'Let's Smurf To Mars', Blossom dreams of going to Mars and can count on her friends to help. (Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids, Sci-Fi & Fantasy) - 1981

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Masks
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle has got another task for the children; making masks.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gym Class
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Scarecrow
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig build a scarecrow.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Market
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and family find some great things to buy from the market and even get a special gift from Mr. Fox's stall.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jukebox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have been sailing with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Back at the clubhouse, they discover a jukebox - but it is very noisy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Petting Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Monkey Trees
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Moving In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hearing Test
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - House Rules
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Health Check
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and more.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Super Potato Movie
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends visit visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dinosaur Party!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have come to play at Granny and Grandpa's house. Everyone dresses as dinosaurs having lots of fun and a bit of a party.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Bedroom
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa helps Danny Dog with a bedroom makeover on the theme of pirates and sea monsters in Danny's Pirate Bedroom.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caring for Grandpa Pig
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Detective Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig requires help in finding his car in the car park.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Perfect Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Monkey Has A Cough
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig teaches Peppa how to wink. Zoe has come to visit with her toy monkey, so Peppa teaches her what she's learnt.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bowling
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog take Peppa, George and Danny bowling. Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig have never been before.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roller Disco
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle has organised a roller disco for the children.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Wildflower Wood
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Paper Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Viking Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Diary
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Panda Twins
nickjrtoo.uk.description: PC Panda brings his twin daughters Peggi and Pandora Panda to playgroup. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries, just like their dad.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Owl
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa is building a special hiding hut to watch birds in.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Magic Trick
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party, and Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Zebra arrives with a new car seat for the baby! Excited to try it in the car, the family soon realise it won't fit with Peppa and George too. It's time for a new car.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Dinosaur Park
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find a birthday treat for Freddy Fox.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Going Boating
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Everyone has come to the lake to go boating, and have a race.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Treasure Hunt
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig bury treasure in their garden. Mummy and Daddy Pig help Peppa and George to find it using a special map.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lunch
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George does not like tomatoes, lettuce or cucumber, even when they have been freshly picked from Grandpa Pig's garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Tooth Fairy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's tooth falls out and she puts it under her pillow. There's a shiny coin under her pillow when she wakes up. How did that happen.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - When I Grow Up
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's time for playgroup and today Peppa and friends are deciding what they might like to be when they grow up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa and George's Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig brings some seeds for Peppa and George to grow a garden. Daddy Pig makes himself useful by being the scarecrow.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George Catches a Cold
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George catches a cold after playing out in the rain, but starts to feel a lot better after he has some nice warm milk.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Toy Plane
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig shares with Peppa and George his love of building toy planes and there is one extra special plane that Granny Pig has yet to see.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Scooters
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. He decides it would be quicker to ride back and he discovers riding scooters is such fun. He shows Mummy Pig how fun it is too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hiccups
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has hiccups and Peppa has fun trying to cure him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Play
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play. Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig help her to learn her lines.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Fire Engine
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George go with Mummy Pig to Miss Rabbit's Mummies Fire Engine Service.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Zoe Zebra the Postman's Daughter
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Zoe Zebra helps her daddy, Mr. Zebra the Postman, deliver birthday party invitations to Peppa and all her friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Potato City
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family visit a new theme park: Potato City. There they discover that the magic of vegetables never ends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Eye Test
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa goes to the opticians for an eye test and tries out spectacles of all different shapes and colours.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Doctors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Tiddles the Tortoise gets stuck in a tree, Pedro Pony has trouble trying to rescue him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bedtime Story
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Olden Days
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sleepy Princess
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is bedtime, and to help Peppa and George go to sleep, Daddy Pig tells them the story of "The Sleepy Princess.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Library
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sailing Boat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George sailing, but they keep getting stuck in the mud.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Fox's Van
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mysteries
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun playing detectives.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Igloo
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Rock Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children learn about the weather. There is a new friend for Peppa, and Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roman Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George dress up as Romans, make a pebble mosaic and even learn a little Latin.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Holiday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Everybody Sleepover!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hospital Sleepover
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Families
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jelly
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy Pig is hard at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Motorbiking
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are in for a treat when they embark on a camping trip to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - A Day With Doctor Hamster
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are spending a day helping Dr Hamster the Vet. They meet so many pets and have such fun.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Weather Station
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup with Madame Gazelle, and the children will be learning about the weather by building a weather station.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Art House Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Robot
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Botanical Gardens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hop, Skip and Jump!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden and together they learn to hop, skip and jump.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Recorders
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle teaches the playgroup to play the recorder. After lots of practice at home, they put on a concert for their parents.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Charity Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George decide to take all the things they don't use anymore to the charity shop, which raises money to help others.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sunny Day Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clouds
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - In The Future
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a sleepover at the Sheep's house, Peppa and Suzy sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are grown up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Creepy Crawly Safari
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Apple Tree
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grownup Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jigsaw Festival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Detective Potato
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy's car goes missing it's up to Detective Potato to find it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Biggest Muddy Puddle In The World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bedtime
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have one more game of jumping up and down in muddy puddles before bedtime.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rebecca Rabbit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George visit Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different to Peppa's house - it is inside a hill! And instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Boat Pond
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends play with their toy boats at the pond.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fish Pond
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fish pond he used to visit when he was a little piggy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cleaning the Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull's New Road
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy's Day Out
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Baby Piggy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cold Winter's Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mirrors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Shoes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gardening
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bat and Ball
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play Bat and Ball, but when it is her turn she hits the ball too far.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hot Dry Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Broken Party Bus
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken bus. This is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sibling School
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Big Announcement
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Science Museum
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her play group are visiting the museum. But not just any museum - it's the Science Museum, where there are lots of buttons to push and things to try out.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George's visit a restaurant, where they have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick believes he's a medical professional in 'Doctor Patrick', and in 'Slumber Party Stars', after Pearl can no longer sleepover with Squidina, the Stars throw Squidina a slumber party. (S4, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family. (S1, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr. Krabs tries to sabotage the circus in 'Big Top Flop', then in 'Sandy, Help Us!', Sandy spends the day solving everyone's issues, only to return home to her own monster of a problem.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Karen tells the fairytale of a nerd trying to steal an action figure in 'Big Bad Bubble Bass', then in 'Sea-Man Sponge Haters Club', Squidward hosts a secret We Hate SpongeBob Club at his house.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: GrandPat competes for Granny Tentacles' love on a dating game show in 'The Dated Game', then in 'Ice Cream Headache', The Ice Cream Man and Ice Cream King team up to capture an icy beast. (S4, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Granny Tentacles helps Squidward collect his paper delivery money from Cecil in 'Backpay Payback', then in 'House Hunting', The Star family house runs away from home. (S1, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick helps with Squidward's paper route in 'Pat-per Route', then in 'Day of the Dartfish', The Dartfish family finds a thief. (S3, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob thinks he's allergic to his pineapple, so Squidward offers to help find him a new home in 'Unreal Estate', then in 'Code Yellow', Squidward is getting a nose job at the local hospital.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob visits his old pal Bubble Buddy's hometown in 'Bubbletown', and in 'Girls' Night Out', Sandy invites Karen and Mrs. Puff for a night on the town, so the ladies decide to blow off some steam.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: The Sharks are the toughest guys in town, but their next confrontation might be too much in 'Sharks vs. Pods', and then in 'CopyBob DittoPants', Plankton clones SpongeBob to steal the secret formula.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and the world in 'Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!', and in 'Chum Fricassee', Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton!

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr. Krabs wishes he could talk to money in 'Money Talks', and then in 'SpongeBob vs the Patty Gadget', SpongeBob battles a patty-making machine. Plus there's a dance contest in 'Slimy Dancing'.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Bikini Bottom think that SpongeBob is a monster in 'The Thing', and then in 'Hocus Pocus', SpongeBob tries to impress Squidward with his new magic kit.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy is out of town for a few days so SpongeBob and Patrick are pet sitting for her in "Wormy", and then in "Patty Hype", SpongeBob invents a brand new culinary sensation! (S2, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs joins in a game of treasure hunt with SpongeBob and Patrick In 'Arrgh!', while in 'Rock Bottom' SpongeBob gets on the wrong bus and finds himself in a strange town. (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob takes it up a notch and tries to show how rugged he is, in 'No Weenies Allowed', and then in 'Squilliam Returns', Squidward tells a big fib to impress his arch nemesis.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob is determined to have a great day in 'The Best Day Ever', and then in 'The Gift Of Gum', Patrick gives SpongeBob a gift - an enormous ball of used chewing gum. Best present ever?

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Squidward gets busted for speeding in his boat (which isn't a speedboat) and is sent back to boating school in 'Boating Buddies'. Then in 'The Krabby Kronicle', Mr Krabs sets up his own newspaper.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

outlaw.us.description: Jim Killian arrives in a small Arizona town hoping to establish a peaceful life as the local preacher, but he soon finds himself in the middle of a feud between sheep ranchers and cattlemen. Leloopa, a young Native American woman, pleads for Killian's help after her shepherd father is hanged by Coke Beck, the vicious son of the head cattle rancher. Killian must weigh his actions carefully lest he perpetuate the cycle of retribution and revenge.

outlaw.us.title: How the West Was Won

Linus then marries daughter Eve Prescott (Carroll Baker), and 30 years later goes off to fight in the Civil War with their son, with bloody results. Eve's sister, Lily (Debbie Reynolds), heads further west and has adventures with a professional gambler (Gregory Peck), stretching all the way to San Francisco and into the 1880s.

Although Garrett and Billy are old friends, the lawman must abide by his duty. However, Garrett and his deputies have great difficulty catching Billy, who is very cunning. Along the way, Billy also gains the assistance of Alias (Bob Dylan), a mysterious knife-wielding stranger.

The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."
