pop.us.description: The BAU races to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital; Prentiss and Unit Chief Andrew Mendoza lead the effort to identify the vigilantes and what's motivating them.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Ashley
pop.us.description: The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire; Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall don't go as planned.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Broken Wing
pop.us.description: A professor from Lewis' past tips off the BAU to an alarming number of overdose deaths of patients who just completed rehab.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Flesh and Blood
pop.us.description: Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts; Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Night Lights
pop.us.description: The BAU team heads to Portland, Ore., to investigate a chilling abduction that may be linked to a local couple who were killed in their home a week earlier.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Hamelin
pop.us.description: The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Chameleon
pop.us.description: Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Sick and Evil
pop.us.description: The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

pop.us.title: NCIS: New Orleans - Monolith
pop.us.description: When Sebastian is injured while unsuccessfully trying to prevent a kidnapping, NCIS races to find the missing woman and her abductors; the team gets a peek into Agent Carter's personal life.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Motorcycle
portlandia.us.description: Peter and Nance try to spice things up in their love life after someone calls Peter an old man; moving a harp.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Feminist Bookstore 10th Anniversary
portlandia.us.description: A 10th anniversary party is thrown for Toni and Candace at the Feminist Bookstore, but a surprise guest shows up with her boyfriend.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - No Olympics
portlandia.us.description: Fred and Carrie convince the Mayor that the Olympics should be barred from Portland but quickly change their minds once they meet Olympian Greg Louganis.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Brunch Village
portlandia.us.description: Peter, Nance, Fred, Carrie, the Mayor and most of the city of Portland find a new brunch spot which annoys Toni and Candace.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Winter in Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: It's wintertime in Portlandia and Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets; Candace's son visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays; a couple tries to keep their food cart in business.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Take Back MTV
portlandia.us.description: Spyke and Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens; a group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor; Sandra has a crush on a mysterious man in her meditation class.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Missionaries
portlandia.us.description: The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland; pedicab driver hustles for clients; Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Nina's Birthday
portlandia.us.description: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The day-long event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night. The party turns into a Tapas Dinner.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Squiggleman
portlandia.us.description: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music; The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement; Malcom and Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Off the Grid
portlandia.us.description: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid; a dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland; musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - The Temp
portlandia.us.description: A temp worker hopes to turn her stint as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help; a wedding is interrupted; local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto; Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Soft Opening
portlandia.us.description: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the soft opening of their bed and breakfast; a magazine features a local furniture maker in their Man Issue; steampunks attend a convention; Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Alexandra
portlandia.us.description: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects; Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate Alexandra; a movie theater sells artisanal concessions. Kath and Dave are concerned about the coyotes in their neighborhood.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - No-Fo-O-Fo-Bridge
portlandia.us.description: The Rats decide to move out of their newly-gentrified neighborhood; first-time parents read various child-rearing books; Gavin and his girlfriend go to the movies; Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Blackout
portlandia.us.description: Electricity is shut off for the entire city as a result of unpaid bills at the Mayor's office; Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Sharing Finances
portlandia.us.description: A young woman is haunted by very smart ghosts; Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another; Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes; Sandra finally finds a soul mate; Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Ecoterrorists
portlandia.us.description: Ecoterrorists protest animal testing at a makeup company; Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out!; Toni and Candace have a car wash; Fred misses hip hop; Dave helps Kath get a good night's sleep.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Celery
portlandia.us.description: A celery salesman goes to great lengths to have celery become more popular; 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets; The Order Grill is open for lunch; Carrie declares social bankruptcy; a fed up office worker wants to become a gutter punk.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Pull-Out King
portlandia.us.description: A punk from the 1980s wakes up from a coma; an e-mail goes neglected; Nina has surprising news for Lance; Malcolm and Kris tailgate a "Prairie Home Companion" live show; Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Spyke Drives
portlandia.us.description: Nance is driven to the emergency room; Gavin questions a singer; Fred and Carrie have a garage sale; dinner guests are held hostage.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Bahama Knights
portlandia.us.description: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert; Fred has an idea for a music documentary; Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife who is the lead singer.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Trailblazers
portlandia.us.description: Toni and Candace coach a dance team; Kickstarter videos compete at a Film Festival; Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Late in Life Drug Use
portlandia.us.description: Mr. Mayor plans a parade; Brendan decides to try drugs; Carrie's brother visits with his new boyfriend.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - 3D Printer
portlandia.us.description: Mr. Mayor uncovers Portland's official 3D printer; Lance and Nina's lizard dies; Santa worries about the future of Christmas.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Getting Away
portlandia.us.description: Toni and Candace lead a feminist retreat for women in New Beaverton, Ohio; Peter and Nance go on a walking tour.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - The Story of Toni and Candace
portlandia.us.description: The origin of the feminist bookstore; a merger between two corporate book retailers pits Toni and Candace against one another in fierce competition to be head of the Chick Lit Department.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - The Fiancee
portlandia.us.description: Lance and Nina feel pressure when Lance's mom and her new boyfriend visit.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Healthcare
portlandia.us.description: Medical solutions are sought when a series of health ailments occurs.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Sea World
portlandia.us.description: The Eco terrorists travel to San Diego to take down their next target, SeaWorld.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - 4th of July
portlandia.us.description: Kath and Dave decide to host an unforgettable 4th of July barbecue; the Mayor searches the deep Web for some very special fireworks.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia - Fashion
portlandia.us.description: Quinn is recruited at Portland's Dollar Store as the face for their rebranding campaign; Spyke faces trial for making unlicensed Bart Simpson merchandise.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Paul O'grady For The Love Of Dogs - Episode 3

sbsbrisbane.au.title: How I Got Here - France: Say Their Names

The trip offers an opportunity to strengthen their relationship and uncover family stories across generations.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out - Lancashire & Morecambe Bay

sbsvicelandperth.au.description: The Viking recreation ship 'Draken' heads up the St. Lawrence River, and down the Hudson River - sailing in spectacular fashion to New York City, with the Statue of Liberty as a backdrop.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: James May: Our Man in... - Hey Bim!
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: In his epic journey across Japan from north to south, James leaves bustling Tokyo to travel to the ancient capital of Kyoto.

sbsvicelandperth.au.title: NITV News Update
sbsvicelandperth.au.description: NITV News recaptures the highlights of Indigenous news around the country.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: This Boy's Life
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A rebellious teen and his mother flee her abusive partner, only to face new struggles when she marries a violent man, forcing the boy to fight for his future.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: A Private Function
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: In the summer of 1947, Britain prepares to commemorate the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Phillip.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Unmoored
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: After confronting her husband over allegations against him, a Swedish TV presenter flees abroad, only to become trapped in a spiral of lies, paranoia and dark secrets.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Go!
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: 'Go Karts' is a thrilling family film about a boy who must overcome tremendous odds and his own recklessness to achieve his dream of winning the National Go Kart Championship.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Storm Boy
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Mike is a lonely boy living in a coastal wilderness with his reclusive father. In search of friendship, he encounters an Indigenous man, and the two form a bond in the care of three pelican chicks.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Paris Can Wait
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Anne takes a road trip to Paris with her husband's associate, Jacques. It is a leisurely trip until she realises that he has been using her credit card to pay their food bills. Starring: Diane Lane, Arnaud Viard, Alec Baldwin.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Eloise At The Plaza
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Eloise, a spirited six-year-old, causes playful chaos under the care of her Nanny Julie Andrews, trying to matchmake a lonely prince and secure an invite to a high-society event.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Unmoored
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: After confronting her husband over allegations against him, a Swedish TV presenter flees abroad, only to become trapped in a spiral of lies, paranoia and dark secrets.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Silver Brumby
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind.

screamboxtv.us.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre
screamboxtv.us.description: S01 E28 Legacy of Blood Three wicked sisters and their equally unsavory husbands arrive at a remote inn where they mean to attend the reading of their uncle's will.

screamboxtv.us.title: Ice Cream Man
screamboxtv.us.description: Some children alert the police to a disturbed vendor who blends human parts into his frozen confections.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Collector
screamboxtv.us.description: A desperate man plans to break into his wealthy employer's house, then learns that another thief has beaten him to it and rigged the place with deadly traps.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Innkeepers
screamboxtv.us.description: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.

screamboxtv.us.title: Heavy Trip
screamboxtv.us.description: A young man is trying to overcome his fears by leading an unknown heavy metal band to the hottest metal festival in Norway. The journey includes heavy metal, grave robbing, Viking heaven, and an armed conflict between Finland and Norway.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Beyond
screamboxtv.us.description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.

screamboxtv.us.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre
screamboxtv.us.description: S01 E28 Legacy of Blood Three wicked sisters and their equally unsavory husbands arrive at a remote inn where they mean to attend the reading of their uncle's will.

screamboxtv.us.title: Creature From the Haunted Sea
screamboxtv.us.description: After political unrest breaks out on a Caribbean island, scheming criminal Renzo Capetto (Anthony Carbone) promises to transport a group of exiles out of the country while also taking part of the national treasury.

screenpix.us.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
screenpix.us.description: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

screenpix.us.title: Born Losers
screenpix.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

screenpix.us.title: The Pride and the Passion
screenpix.us.description: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

screenpix.us.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
screenpix.us.description: A rebel leader educates a Dominican Republic woman (Salma Hayek) about the abuses of a corrupt dictator (Edward James Olmos).

screenpix.us.title: Park Row
screenpix.us.description: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

screenpixaction.us.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
screenpixaction.us.description: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Creeping Unknown
screenpixaction.us.description: A British rocket scientist (Brian Donlevy) hunts an astronaut monstrously enveloped by an alien fungus.

screenpixaction.us.title: Reptilicus
screenpixaction.us.description: Copenhagen is terrorized by a prehistoric beast that has regenerated itself from a recently discovered tail segment.

screenpixaction.us.title: Voodoo Island
screenpixaction.us.description: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors.

screenpixaction.us.title: Portrait in Terror
screenpixaction.us.description: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

screenpixaction.us.title: Incident in an Alley
screenpixaction.us.description: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpixaction.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Eve of Destruction
screenpixvoices.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

screenpixvoices.us.title: J.D.'s Revenge
screenpixvoices.us.description: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elijah Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Act of Vengeance
screenpixvoices.us.description: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Caesar
screenpixvoices.us.description: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mandela
screenpixvoices.us.description: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mercenary Fighters
screenpixvoices.us.description: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Windprints
screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

screenpixvoices.us.title: For Us, the Living
screenpixvoices.us.description: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened. (movie) - 1983

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mandela
screenpixvoices.us.description: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage. (movie) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets. (movie) - 1986

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Along Came Jones
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Seeing the initials "MJ" on his saddle, the people of Payneville mistake Jones for the treacherous bandit Monte Jarrad (Dan Duryea), and they nearly kill him before he is rescued by Cherry de Longpre (Loretta Young). Grateful for her help, Jones falls for Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Day of the Outlaw
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Lone Gun
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A marshal (George Montgomery) courts a rancher's sister (Dorothy Malone) and rids a town of rustlers.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Dalton Girls
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Death of Bat Masterson
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Bat arrives at a mining town in Bonanza, Colo., to collect $20,000 in earnings from a cattle drive, he discovers the town believes him dead and gave his money to a woman claiming to be his widow.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Secret Is Death
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The territorial administrator seeks Bat's help in stemming a crime wave in Cheyenne.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Memory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Liz Dothan persuades Sam Wade to place her jewelry overnight in the Wells Fargo safe, and remembers the combination as she watches him open it; Hollister's sharp mind and keen observations help him solve the subsequent $20,000 theft.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Revenge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Jonas Bell is killed in a scuffle with Hollister after a bank clerk is murdered; siblings Noah and Lady Bell conspire to avenge their father targeting Hollister.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blood Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Rebel in Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Valdez Is Coming
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Halliday Brand
screenpixwesterns.us.description: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: More Dead Than Alive
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him. (movie) - 1969

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Fever
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After growing up living a life of crime, outlaw Sam Weller (John Lupton) decides to go straight, but neither Sam's father, Trench (Aaron Saxon), nor his thieving cohort, Charlie Whitman (Norman Frederic), take the news well. After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon. (movie) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Law Rides Again
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent. (movie) - 1943

scrippsnews.us.description: What happened today? Find out as Scripps News gets you up to speed on the day's events that everyone is talking about.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Dual Threat
scrippsnews.us.description: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - Georgia at South Carolina
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 1 Georgia Bulldogs (9-1, 7-1 SEC) visit the No. 21 South Carolina Gamecocks (6-4, 4-4) in Columbia. Georgia enters after beating Missouri 48-21, while South Carolina seeks to rebound at home following a 34-6 loss to Arkansas.

secnetwork.us.title: SEC Now - Open Mic ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: News and information show hosted by either Peter Burns, Dari Nowkhah or Alyssa Lang, joined by various network analysts, discussing all the SEC news of the day.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

secnetwork.us.title: SEC Now
secnetwork.us.description: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is "SEC Now," broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, Peter Burns or Alyssa Lang, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams.

secnetwork.us.title: Women's College Volleyball - SEC Tournament, Championship: Teams TBA ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: From Enmarket Arena in Savannah, Ga.

shadesofblack.us.description: A father hides his wife's drug addiction from his daughter.

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball
shadesofblack.us.description: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

shadesofblack.us.title: Cut Throat City
shadesofblack.us.description: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

shadesofblack.us.title: Mr. Church
shadesofblack.us.description: When a young girl and her dying mother are joined by a black male cook who comes to live with them, little do they know that their lives are about to change forever.

shadesofblack.us.title: Christmas in Compton
shadesofblack.us.description: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

shadesofblack.us.title: Medusa Deluxe
shadesofblack.us.description: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

shadesofblack.us.title: Never Back Down
shadesofblack.us.description: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

shoutmovies.us.title: The Last Seduction
shoutmovies.us.description: An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

shoutmovies.us.title: Compromising Positions
shoutmovies.us.description: The murder of a swinging Long Island dentist puts an ex-reporter housewife (Susan Sarandon) onto a story.

shoutmovies.us.title: The Last Unicorn
shoutmovies.us.description: An inept magician (Alan Arkin) and a ragged scullery woman (Tammy Grimes) join a unicorn's (Mia Farrow) quest to free her kind from an evil king's ocean prison.

shoutmovies.us.title: My Best Fiend
shoutmovies.us.description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

shoutmovies.us.title: Trial by Jury
shoutmovies.us.description: A New York mob boss (Armand Assante) tries to ensure his acquittal by scaring a single mother (Joanne Whalley-Kilmer) on the jury.

shoutmovies.us.title: The Warrior's Way
shoutmovies.us.description: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, a master swordsman (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town.

shoutmovies.us.title: A Tale of Two Guns
shoutmovies.us.description: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

shoutmovies.us.title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger
shoutmovies.us.description: A chance meeting with a film director leads to a waitress turned actress's transformation into a consummate superhero.

showtime.us.title: Gravity
showtime.us.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

showtime.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtime.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

showtime.us.title: World Trade Center
showtime.us.description: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

showtime.us.title: Pike River
showtime.us.description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

showtime.us.title: Yellowjackets
showtime.us.description: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later.

showtime.us.title: Dexter: Resurrection
showtime.us.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right.

showtime.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtime.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

showtime.us.title: Sleepless
showtime.us.description: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) finds himself caught in a high-stakes web of corrupt cops, internal affairs and murderous gangsters. When a failed heist leads to the kidnapping of his teenage son (Octavius J. Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice.

showtime.us.title: Killer Joe
showtime.us.description: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). (Crime drama)

showtime.us.title: No Country for Old Men
showtime.us.description: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. (Crime drama)

showtime2west.us.title: A.C.O.D.
showtime2west.us.description: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book.

showtime2west.us.title: Snoopy, Come Home
showtime2west.us.description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

showtime2west.us.title: The Guilt Trip
showtime2west.us.description: Pressured into taking his overbearing mother along for the ride, a man embarks on the road trip of a lifetime.

showtime2west.us.title: Homestead
showtime2west.us.description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

showtime2west.us.title: Ballistic
showtime2west.us.description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

showtime2west.us.title: Not Without Hope
showtime2west.us.description: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

showtime2west.us.title: The Back-up Plan
showtime2west.us.description: A single woman (Jennifer Lopez) meets the man (Alex O'Loughlin) of her dreams on the same day she becomes pregnant through artificial insemination.

showtime2west.us.title: No Strings Attached
showtime2west.us.description: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical.

showtime2west.us.title: It Gets Worse
showtime2west.us.description: S01 E05 Stop All The Cocks Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

showtime2west.us.title: It Gets Worse
showtime2west.us.description: S01 E06 People Team Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

showtime2west.us.title: Hostage
showtime2west.us.description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Rosemary's Baby
showtimeextreme.us.description: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Venom
showtimeextreme.us.description: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Persona
showtimeextreme.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
showtimeextreme.us.description: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Reindeer Games
showtimeextreme.us.description: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeextreme.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

showtimefamily.us.title: Mouse Hunt
showtimefamily.us.description: Brothers (Nathan Lane, Lee Evans) inherit a dilapidated mansion inhabited by a resourceful rodent that refuses to leave.

showtimefamily.us.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
showtimefamily.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

showtimefamily.us.title: Mr. Holmes
showtimefamily.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

showtimefamily.us.title: Charlotte's Web
showtimefamily.us.description: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider (Julia Roberts) weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
showtimefamily.us.description: Complications arise after two bachelors (Rupert Everett, Colin Firth) make use of the same pseudonym in 19th-century England.

showtimefamily.us.title: Harriet the Spy
showtimefamily.us.description: Spying on and writing about family, friends and neighbors turn a preteen aspiring novelist (Michelle Trachtenberg) into an outsider.

showtimefamily.us.title: Stardust
showtimefamily.us.description: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

showtimefamily.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
showtimefamily.us.description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sahara
showtimefamily.us.description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimefamily.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

showtimefamily.us.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
showtimefamily.us.description: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
showtimefamily.us.description: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom.

showtimenext.us.title: Blue Eyed Girl
showtimenext.us.description: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been.

showtimenext.us.title: War Pony
showtimenext.us.description: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood.

showtimenext.us.title: Chocolat
showtimenext.us.description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

showtimenext.us.title: The Kid
showtimenext.us.description: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

showtimenext.us.title: Brave the Dark
showtimenext.us.description: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: You Can Count on Me
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Magic Mike
showtimeshowcase.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Weather Man
showtimeshowcase.us.description: David Spritz (Nicolas Cage) is a Chicago weatherman who, despite success at his job, is deeply unhappy. Eclipsed by his father, Robert (Michael Caine), a celebrated author, and licking his wounds after his marriage to Noreen (Hope Davis) collapses, David resolves to get his life in order by applying for a high-profile job on a New York City talk show. But with his personal life a shambles, David must decide between fast-tracking his career and repairing his rapidly deteriorating family life.

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Death of Stalin
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

showtimewomen.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimewomen.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

showtimewomen.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimewomen.us.description: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

showtimewomen.us.title: A Perfect Murder
showtimewomen.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

showtimewomen.us.title: Nine
showtimewomen.us.description: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench).

showtimewomen.us.title: Dreamgirls
showtimewomen.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Freedom's Path
shoxbetwest.us.description: When Union soldier William runs from battle, he's taken to safety by a heroic young Black man. Kitch is part of a secret community of freed slaves running a section of the Underground Railroad, but a desperate slave catcher is on their trail.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Undisputed
shoxbetwest.us.description: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Bang Bang
shoxbetwest.us.description: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!
shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Violent Heart
shoxbetwest.us.description: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. (Thriller, Drama) - 2020

skyaction.uk.title: Mutiny
skyaction.uk.description: Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.

skyaction.uk.title: Bad Boys
skyaction.uk.description: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million worth of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

skyaction.uk.title: Bad Boys II
skyaction.uk.description: Loose-cannon cops Lowrey and Burnett reduce Miami to rubble as they try to stop Cuban and Russian drug smugglers from flooding Florida with ecstasy.

skyaction.uk.title: Bad Boys for Life
skyaction.uk.description: Old-school cops Mike Lowery and Marcus Burnett team up to take down the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel. Newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department along with Mike and Marcus go up against the ruthless Armando Armas.

skyaction.uk.title: The Mechanic
skyaction.uk.description: Ace assassin Arthur Bishop becomes a target when he agrees to teach reckless Steve the art of contract killing.

skyaction.uk.title: Hummingbird
skyaction.uk.description: Reeling from a traumatic tour of duty in Afghanistan, Joey, a former special forces soldier, returns to London to face another kind of war: life on the streets as a damaged, homeless veteran. In an attempt to rehabilitate himself, Joey assumes another man's identity and seeks the aid of Sister Cristina, a young nun who works at an inner-city parish.

skyaction.uk.title: The Legend of Tarzan
skyaction.uk.description: It's been nearly a decade since Tarzan, also known as John Clayton III, left Africa to live in Victorian England with his wife Jane. Danger lurks on the horizon as Leon Rom, a treacherous envoy for King Leopold, devises a scheme that lures the couple to the Congo. Rom plans to capture Tarzan and deliver him to an old enemy in exchange for diamonds. When Jane becomes a pawn in his devious plot, Tarzan must return to the jungle to save the woman he loves.

skyaction.uk.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Laughs
skyaction.uk.description: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! From Nativity! to Office Christmas Party, get into the festive spirit with this week's Christmas laughs Cinema List!

skyaction.uk.title: Demolition Man
skyaction.uk.description: Violence has been outlawed in the politically correct regime of 2032, and the only weapons in existence are consigned to a museum, but when an escaped psychopath heads straight for the museum, the authorities decide the only effective recourse they have is to thaw out a violent, cryogenically frozen cop.

skyadventure.uk.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
skyadventure.uk.description: In The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Mario and crew blast off on an epic journey and encounter new worlds, iconic characters and unexpected threats.

skyadventure.uk.title: Smurfs
skyadventure.uk.description: When Papa Smurf is taken by evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads the Smurfs on a mission to the real world to save him.

skyadventure.uk.title: Penguins Of Madagascar
skyadventure.uk.description: A group of wisecracking penguins join forces with an undercover organisation to stop a dastardly villain. Animated adventure with the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch.

skyadventure.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skyadventure.uk.description: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

skyadventure.uk.title: Liar Liar
skyadventure.uk.description: Slick lawyer Jim Carrey is a big fibber, but when his son makes a wish, he can tell nothing but the truth for 24 hours. Comedy. Strong language/moderate sexual references.

skyadventure.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skyadventure.uk.description: Yogi and Boo-Boo must save Jellystone Park in this live action version of the classic cartoon. Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake voice the misbehaving bears.(78mins).

skyadventure.uk.title: Happy Feet Two
skyadventure.uk.description: Pirouetting penguin Mumble is back, fighting to save his melting Antarctic home in this animation. With Elijah Wood, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon. Flashing images.

skyadventure.uk.title: Open Season
skyadventure.uk.description: Pampered bear Boog (Martin Lawrence) teams up with fast-talking deer Elliott (Ashton Kutcher) after becoming stranded in the woods three days before open season. Animation.

skyadventure.uk.title: Dog Man
skyadventure.uk.description: A man and his dog are fused together to turn into Dog Man. They must stop a cat from cloning himself and creating an evil kitten.

skyadventure.uk.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
skyadventure.uk.description: In The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Mario and crew blast off on an epic journey and encounter new worlds, iconic characters and unexpected threats.

skyarts.uk.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
skyarts.uk.description: The winner of Landscape Artist of the Year 2018 begins a special commission from the Imperial War Museum to mark the centenary of The First World War Armistice. (9 of 9)

skyarts.uk.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
skyarts.uk.description: The Eavesdropper: Moira hears a woman discussing a trip to Paris with her lover Donald. Not only is her husband called Donald, but he was in France last week. Coincidence? (S5, ep 2)

skyarts.uk.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
skyarts.uk.description: Operation Safecrack: In an attempt to prove their safes are impregnable, a company challenges ex-safebreaker Sam to crack one for a cash prize. But are his skills sharp enough? (S5, ep 3)

skyarts.uk.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
skyarts.uk.description: Death of a Cop: A remorseful detective vows to find the men who murdered his son, who followed in his footsteps and also became a cop. (S1, ep 31)

skyarts.uk.description: New. Mahler takes the audience on a journey. The piece is famous for its structural architecture with themes of love, life and death. With the London Philharmonic Orchestra. (3 of 5)

skyarts.uk.title: Amadeus
skyarts.uk.description: Constanze refuses to accept Salieri's role in Mozart's death. Years later, she reflects on Mozart's final days. With distressing scenes. (5 of 5)

skyarts.uk.title: Dickens In Italy With David Harewood
skyarts.uk.description: David Harewood investigates the impact Italy had on Charles Dickens, discovering that the quintessentially English author was far more cosmopolitan than expected.

skyarts.uk.title: Science Fiction In The Atomic Age
skyarts.uk.description: Quatermass to Christopher Nolan: Space travel redefines human potential, reviving exploration and conquest while inspiring innovation and unity. (S1, ep 4)

skyarts.uk.title: Alec Guinness: A Class Act
skyarts.uk.description: Recounted through family, friends and peers, explore the brilliant career of late Oscar winner Alec Guinness - beginning with his 1934 debut at the Playhouse Theatre.

skyarts.uk.title: New: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026 ᴺᵉʷ
skyarts.uk.description: New. Nine artists paint food critic Grace Dent or comedians Munya Chawawa and Grace Campbell. Who will claim the final semi-final place? (S13, ep 8)

skyarts.uk.title: Anish Kapoor: Stupid Naughty Boy
skyarts.uk.description: Tasked with the installation of two ambitious shows during the Venice Biennale of 2022, the 70-year-old Anish Kapoor is documented by art critic Waldemar Januszczak.

skyarts.uk.title: David Lynch: The Directors
skyarts.uk.description: Remembering the life of David Lynch, the Academy Award-winning director behind Mulholland Drive, Blue Velvet and The Elephant Man, whose visionary work reshaped cinema. (S5, ep 6)

skyarts.uk.title: The Eighties
skyarts.uk.description: The AIDS Crisis: A look at how the 1980s saw a mysterious and lethal illness known as AIDS develop into a pandemic with enormous political and cultural consequences.

skyarts.uk.title: Gods Of The Game
skyarts.uk.description: Including a trained football fan chorus to mark the World Cup, this operatic tale about the corruption that shrouds the beautiful game at present combines arias and musical pieces.

skyarts.uk.title: The Joy Of Painting
skyarts.uk.description: Evening Waterfall: Bob shares a truly unique piece while painting a flowing river with rapids on black canvas. (S12, ep 8)

skyarts.uk.title: The Joy Of Painting
skyarts.uk.description: Tropical Seascape: Bob demonstrates how to paint an exotic ocean masterpiece, complete with palm trees swaying in the warm breeze. (S12, ep 9)

skyarts.uk.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
skyarts.uk.description: Hijack: A hijacker on an aeroplane takes a stewardess hostage before demanding a million dollars and a parachute. Will Captain Waterhouse give in to his demands? (S4, ep 17)

skyarts.uk.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
skyarts.uk.description: Blue Marigold: Dropped by her agency for her diva-like behaviour, supermodel Marigold's mental health deteriorates. Years later, she plots a comeback. (S5, ep 1)

skyarts.uk.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
skyarts.uk.description: Six People, No Music: A mortician is torn when a dead man awakens to make his own funeral plans. (S4, ep 13)

skyarts.uk.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
skyarts.uk.description: The Morning After: A mother gets involved when she discovers her daughter is seeing a married man. (S4, ep 14)

skyarts.uk.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
skyarts.uk.description: Death of a Cop: A remorseful detective vows to find the men who murdered his son, who followed in his footsteps and also became a cop. (S1, ep 31)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Billions
skyatlantic.uk.description: Boasts & Rails: Axe receives a tip about a mole inside his company, throwing the US Attorney's case into jeopardy. Later, a secret from Axe's past surfaces. (S1, ep 8)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Task
skyatlantic.uk.description: Family Statements: As Tom's family braces for an emotional court date, Robbie faces a dilemma and Maeve makes a critical choice. (2 of 7)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Task
skyatlantic.uk.description: Nobody's Stronger Than Forgiveness: As Cliff and Robbie look for a buyer, Aleah and Lizzie question Peaches' former coworkers. (3 of 7)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Fargo
skyatlantic.uk.description: Law Away: Josto Fadda makes a bold move, Loy Cannon battles his demons and Oraetta Mayflower silences her critics.(S4, ep 7)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Accidentally Famous:...
skyatlantic.uk.description: ...The Story of 883: Max and Mauro's story continues as their first summer as famous singers comes to an end; new challenges await them.  (S2, ep 1)

skyatlantic.uk.title: Accidentally Famous:...

slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Nightmare on Broad Street
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Hail to the King
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Method Man's Mego
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Stash Bash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - In a Galaxy Very Nearby
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Ode to Clerks
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Canine Crusaders
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Power Man vs. Counter Man
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Troma-tized
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - A Pez-tacular Mystery
slightlyoffifc.us.description: The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - The Mightiest of Mortals
slightlyoffifc.us.description: When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Pop Goes the Stash
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Junk
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Life After Clerks
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Commercial
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Zombies
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.

slightlyoffifc.us.title: Comic Book Men - Con Gone Wrong
slightlyoffifc.us.description: Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Build That? - Swamps & Swagger
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Exploring behind-the-scenes of design and construction of revolutionary buildings in Spain, New York and a university campus in Florida.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Sealing Nevada's Abandoned Mines
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Nevada has over 40,000 abandoned mines posing dangers; Mike joins contractors for a week to secure five sites; alongside biologists, they explore and document wildlife; reaching these isolated mines requires barges, helicopters and bulldozers.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Dunkirk
smithsonianchannel.us.description: First-hand accounts, recreations and expert interviews of the battle of Dunkirk, and how soldiers were trapped on the French beach by German forces.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - D-Day
smithsonianchannel.us.description: First-hand accounts, re-creations and expert interviews of D-Day in 1944, where the Allied Forces of Britain, America, Canada and France attacked German forces on the coast of Normandy, France.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Pearl Harbor
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor triggers the U.S. entering WWII; we reveal the secret stories behind the battle such as that of Dorie Miller.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - The Battle of Britain
smithsonianchannel.us.description: There are many stories behind the 1940 Battle of Britain, like pilot Bill Millington who sacrifices himself to save civilians.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - The Blitz
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The tales behind the Blitz; the employment of German speaking radio controllers to confuse Luftwaffe pilots; the French spy who helped the RAF.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Behind Enemy Lines
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Exploring the many battles fought out on the banks of the Rhine in 1944 and the secrets behind the lines of the battleground.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: America's Hidden Stories - Forged in Slavery
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The discovery of a pre-Civil War cemetery of enslaved ironworkers provides new insights into the role African-Americans played in the Industrial Revolution.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships - Nieuw Statendam
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: One of Holland America Line's largest cruisers makes its debut in the Caribbean, highlighted by a visit to an exclusive private island resort. Nieuw Statendam - S04E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships - Sky Princess
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The Sky Princess carries passengers from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, to three Central American stops. Sky Princess - S04E08

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Filled with big toys, guests fly the trapeze, surf and skydive without ever leaving the world's most innovative cruise ship. Quantum of the Seas - S08E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships - Paul Gauguin
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The Paul Gauguin offers five-star luxury while sailing near the coral reefs, mountainous islands and tropical playgrounds of French Polynesia. Paul Gauguin - S01E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships - Le Soléal
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: New luxury liner Le Soleal navigates the uncharted waters of Indonesia to give her passengers one-of-a-kind encounters at exotic destinations. Le Soléal - S01E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Cruise Ships - Celebrity Solstice
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Facing Australia's fierce heat, Celebrity Solstice provides guests with views of waterfalls, jumping crocodiles, koalas and the Great Barrier Reef. Celebrity Solstice - S01E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains - Kiwi Rail
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Two magnificent journeys with New Zealand's KiwiRail: the TranzAlpine, a five-hour journey across 223 kilometers, and Northern Explorer, an 11-hour trip through five unique regions of the North Island. Kiwi Rail - S02E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Ships - Crystal Serenity
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The world's top cruise ship, the Crystal Serenity visits Sydney harbor, the port of Melbourne, Bali, a large-scale furniture load in Semarang, Indonesia and the port of Singapore. Crystal Serenity - S06E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains - The Shinkansen
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Japan's Tōkaidō Shinkansen, known as the bullet train, operates on a dedicated railway line at up to 177 mph. The Shinkansen - S01E02
